QuestInfo.name: One Who Sees Darkness
QuestInfo.0: What are eyes that see darkness? Ask Grendel the Really Old.
QuestInfo.1: #bDouble-click on the #i2430873# Vampiric Lantern#k to get to the Giant Tree and #beliminate 50 Evil Eyes#k. #bDouble-click on the Vampiric Lantern#k to return when all's said and done.
QuestInfo.2: You've gathered all four paradoxes in the Vampiric Lantern.\r\n#r* You need to reach Lv. 28 to proceed to the next quest.#k\r\n

0.0: Let's get back to it. The final paradox is fairly straightforward: it's about the Evil Eyes of the Giant Tree near Ellinia.\r\n#L0##bDo those monsters have something to do with eyes?#l\n#k
0.1: That's it. Evil Eyes used to hide in the deep ends of caves, and they evolved so their sight is much better in darkness than in light.

yes.0: This is it! #bDouble-click on the Vampiric Lantern#k to get to the Giant Tree and defeat #b50 Evil Eyes#k. Then all that will be left is to finish your ritual.

no.0: What? Is it something I said?

1.0: Now THAT is a Vampiric Lantern.\r\n#L0##bThe power of this lantern flows through me!#l\n#k
1.1: Er, right. Well, I appreciated this chance to satisfy my curiosity about your paradoxes.\r\n#r* You need to reach Lv. 28 to proceed to the next quest.#k\r\n

mob.0: Look for large eyeballs. It's very unusual for monsters that live in the darkness to have such looks. Cheer up, for this will be your last mission.
